partially_covered.missing: Ontology provides orgName and address for Organization, but does not explicitly define all possible 'information displayed' or extensibility for organization metadata.
Ontology does not formalize file format constraints or required fields for validity (e.g., no SHACL, no OWL cardinality restrictions on required fields).

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are fully addressed by existing classes and properties. CQ5 and CQ13 are only partially covered due to lack of extensibility for organization information and missing formal constraints on required data for file validity.

strengths: Consistent use of restrictions and functional properties
Good use of equivalence for BuyerParticipation
weaknesses: No GCAs (General Class Axioms) for higher-level inferences
Limited class hierarchy depth (no subclasses for OrganizationRole, Item, etc.)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7 (Missing domain or range in some properties if extended)
P19 (Lack of explicit cardinality for required properties)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Formalize file validity constraints (CQ13) using OWL cardinality restrictions or SHACL to specify required fields (e.g., every Invoice must have invoiceNumber, invoiceAmount, at least one InvoiceItem, and at least one InvoiceParticipation).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Ensures data completeness and improves reasoner/validator feedback.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Enrich Organization and Item classes with extensible properties (e.g., tax ID, contact info, item code) and consider subclassing OrganizationRole (e.g., Buyer, Seller) and Item (e.g., Product, Service).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves CQ5 coverage and supports future extensibility.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add General Class Axioms (GCAs) for common participation patterns (e.g., every Invoice with a BuyerParticipation must have an Organization with role Buyer).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables more expressive queries and inferences.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce disjoint unions for OrganizationRole and Item subclasses if/when defined.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Prevents class overlap and improves logical clarity.

summary: The ontology provides strong coverage for the EDIFACT invoice scenario and answers nearly all competency questions with appropriate OWL 2 constructs and annotations. Improvements are needed to formalize file validity constraints and enrich organization/item information for better extensibility and completeness.
